explication: Super-Linter is a containerized multi-language linting and formatting action. Its main workflow is to accept a repository for analysis, run configured linters in parallel, and report findings to the console and GitHub Actions status checks; it also supports fixing issues. The README documents these product capabilities, but the provided source excerpts do not show runtime call sites, so internal connections are marked unverified rather than inferred as direct calls.
